layers.name: Empyrealm
layers.doc: OA's embedding-plus-hybrid-Mamba core with one canonical Rust execution path.
layers.adaptation: Complete Rust hybrid composition diverging from the donor's renamed Mamba-3 copies: embedding plus an interleaved Mamba-3/causal-attention block stack (Nemotron-style), pre-normalized residual mixers, dense or routed-expert SwiGLU feed-forward tails and a final RMSNorm; preserves seeded child construction, the embed/block_*/tail-norm checkpoint tree, checked U8/U32 token and FP32 embedded shapes, and extends the caller-owned decode state across per-block Mamba3State and AttentionCache slots; renames public EmpyrealmCore to Empyrealm
